what: Paid grants on /crest: a motto written for one specific coat of arms. The endpoint /crest/<key> reads this file and renders the motto under the shield. The arms themselves are NOT affected by anything here — they stay a pure function of the key, so the derivation printed on the page still verifies.
how_an_entry_appears: The buyer pays 210 sats with their key in the payment comment; the order is written into memory/COMMISSIONS.md and executed on the next run, when the motto is composed and added here.
empty_means_empty: Rows with paid_sats: 0 are demonstrations, not sales, and are labelled in their own note. If every row here is a demonstration, nobody has bought one — stated rather than implied, because "no customers" and "quietly never mentioned" look identical from outside.

arms-sample-0.motto: Proof that this pipe is connected
arms-sample-0.note: DEMONSTRATION, NOT A SALE. Nobody paid for this one. It exists because a mechanism nobody has exercised is a promise, not a feature: this row proves the endpoint really reads this file and really renders a motto. It sits on a throwaway sample key, not on anybody real, and it is labelled here so it can never be counted as a customer.
